text: It might sound weird but I genuinely enjoy these type of market conditions. Obviously not the PNL factor and lack of opportunities, but everything else that comes with it. Often times when I reflect on my most memorable moments in crypto/trading, it's either from myself or the markets being at rock bottom. There's a peacefulness that comes with it. Everything slows down, you get to think clearly, realize what peak froth looked like, realize what peak despair feels like, reassess your risk management/trading framework, research narratives with real value, play with new products or ideas, find new interesting accounts, read books or podcasts etc. Instead of being at the mercy of 5 min charts and the unproductive habits that come with it, you can take a step back and approach markets with a healthy mindset. You get stimulated by things which are actually interesting, not because the coin ran to 30 mil in 48 hours. It's the same feeling I get walking on the beach next to a calm ocean. Only your most pure thoughts are able to enter and a calmness comes over you. When onchains hot you don't get time to reflect on mistakes or build the foundation that's going to genuinely let you scale as a person and trader. Being around for the bear markets and low activity lets you reflect on your biggest weaknesses and confront the truth about your own discipline. All the biggest changes in my habits and work ethics have been born from these environments as I'm forced to sit there with the sobering reality of where I've gone wrong. You can't escape as there's no stimulation from lack of trades, gc messages, new projects to dd etc. I also really love the idea of being one of the very few who are still watching, research, writing, experimenting etc while 99% have tapped out. Same with the gym, I love being the first in and last out. Time and time again you'll see the biggest performers are those who put in the hours and forced themselves infront of the screen when markets are shit. Even if there's nothing happening onchain etc, you're still exposed to news stories, how people react to them, new cultural changes on the micro level and sentiment towards them, whats the flavour of the days discussion -> how do assets reflect that? All of this is adding tiny lego pieces to your intuition. When you do this for long enough you speak the native language of the internet and can forecast how people respond in the short, mid and long term to major events. Anyone can show up in good conditions when the hot ball of money is being thrown around without care, very few can pay attention year round with the same energy and passion for their craft. Simply the most unbeatable trait.
